senses.gloss:
ITA-5.58.10 puṣkarikā पुष्करिका
Vesicle consisting of many smaller vesicles and resembling a lotus petal on the penis
A disease of the penis characterized by a boil resembling the bud of a lotus flower (padmapuṣkarasaṃsthānā piḍakā/ padmakarṇikasaṃsthānā piḍakā); studded with boils.

ITA-5.72.7 puṣpa-viṣaḥ पुष्प-विषः
Poisonous flowers
Poisoning characterized by vomiting; abdominal distension; confusion/delirium.

ITA-7.2.6.6 puṣharāgam पुष्परागम्
Yellow sapphire, topaz
Duly processed pushyaraga is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbomineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-1.9.3.2.28 puṣpitaḥ पुष्पितः
Person showing signs of impending death
A person with fatal prognostic signs.
